Download npm artifacts

Download the tarball of a package version: rp reads the packument
(GET &lt;repo&gt;/&lt;package&gt;), picks the version (--version takes a version or a
dist-tag; default the "latest" tag), downloads the dist.tarball URL of that
version and verifies the tarball against dist.integrity (SHA-512) and
dist.shasum (SHA-1). The file is &lt;name&gt;-&lt;version&gt;.tgz; a scope is not part of
the file name, as in npm.

If dist.tarball points to another host than the repository (a registry behind
a proxy that rewrites the address), rp fetches the same file from the
repository host by its canonical path instead of sending credentials anywhere
else.

```
rp download npm <package> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --dir string       Directory to store the file in (created when missing) (default ".")
      --force            Replace the file when it already exists
      --repo string      Repository to download from (required)
      --version string   Version to download (default: the newest the format knows)
```
